CASE
  WHEN stage = 'rejected' THEN CASE WHEN rejection_reason = 'approval_denied' THEN 'denied' ELSE 'refused' END
  WHEN outcome = 'succeeded' THEN CASE WHEN outcome_verified AND outcome_source = 'provider' THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'acknowledged' END
  WHEN outcome = 'failed' THEN 'failed'
  WHEN outcome = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown'
  ELSE 'pending'
END

action_effects_outcome_source_check.name: action_effects_outcome_source_check
action_effects_outcome_source_check.value: outcome_source IS NULL OR outcome_source IN ('provider', 'manual', 'system')

impact_limit_periods_non_negative.name: impact_limit_periods_non_negative
impact_limit_periods_non_negative.value: consumed >= 0 AND reserved >= 0 AND unknown_exposure >= 0 AND unknown_exposure <= reserved

impact_limits_currency_check.name: impact_limits_currency_check
impact_limits_currency_check.value: (dimension = 'money' AND currency ~ '^[a-z]{3}$') OR (dimension <> 'money' AND currency IS NULL)

impact_reservations_amounts_check.name: impact_reservations_amounts_check
impact_reservations_amounts_check.value: amount >= 0 AND settled_amount >= 0 AND released_amount >= 0 AND settled_amount + released_amount <= amount

oauth_connections_end_user_unique.name: oauth_connections_end_user_unique
oauth_connections_end_user_unique.where: subject_end_user_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND pending_confirmation_until IS NULL
